fields.description: Customer the decision is about. Addressable so a targeted pilot can be scoped by IN on a small list, not for general rule logic.
Account the decision is about, and the champion/challenger allocation key.
Collection case, when one is open. Nullable — test it with IS_NULL / NOT_NULL to write pre-case versus in-case rules.
Days past due, whole days, 0 when the account is current. Supplied by delinquency-service; the canonical bucketing input.
Delinquency bucket code from the versioned bucket configuration, e.g. CURRENT, 1-30, 31-60, 90+. Configurable per portfolio, so compare with EQ or IN and never with an ordering operator.
Amount overdue in MAJOR currency units, e.g. 500.00 means EUR 500.00 — write thresholds as "500", never as 50000 minor units. Compared as an exact decimal.
ISO-4217 currency of the overdue amount and the balance. Test it before comparing an amount in a multi-currency portfolio.
Product the account belongs to, for product-specific treatment eligibility. Source-system code carried through unchanged.
Total outstanding balance in MAJOR currency units, in the account's currency. Used for exposure-based segmentation.
Account status published by account-service, e.g. OPEN, CLOSED, WRITTEN_OFF. Vocabulary owned by that service, so compare with EQ or IN.
Derived contactability band: HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW or UNCONTACTABLE. Derived by customer-service so that constraints already override stated preferences.
Preferred channel: SMS, EMAIL, LETTER, CALL, DIGITAL or NONE. An input to optimization, never an override of policy.
Customer-level do-not-contact flag. A policy constraint, not a preference: true means no automated contact, and the pre-dispatch guard re-checks it.
Customer is flagged vulnerable or in an assistance programme. True narrows treatments to the vulnerability-safe set.
Customer segment code published by customer-service, used by strategy eligibility and segmentation.
An arrangement is active and being honoured. Almost every strategy suppresses collection contact while this is true.
A promise to pay is open: made, not yet due, neither kept nor broken.
Promises broken in the last 90 days. The usual escalation trigger out of the light-touch treatment ladder.
Contact attempts in the last 7 days across every channel. Frequency-cap rules read this; the pre-dispatch guardrail check is separate and authoritative.
Contact attempts in the last 30 days across every channel.
SMS attempts in the last 7 days. Absent from the context means zero, and a leaf on a missing field evaluates false, so compare with GTE rather than EQ 0.
Email attempts in the last 7 days.
Letters sent in the last 7 days.
Collector call attempts in the last 7 days.
Digital/in-app contacts in the last 7 days.
When the most recent contact attempt was made, RFC3339 UTC. Nullable when the customer has never been contacted — test it with IS_NULL / NOT_NULL.
